   Home baseline: supplied v0.10.135 implementation
   Main page: Assembly 1.10b adapter */

(function(){'use strict';

/* =========================================================
LCARS Mk II - OP BRIDGE
v0.10.135 - External Shell CSS Architecture
========================================================= */

var VERSION='0.10.130';
var SHELL_URL='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/GMHooly/gmhooly@main/lcars-mkii-shell-v0.10.135.html';
var area5DefaultButtonSrc='';

/* =========================================================
AREA 1 - PAGE SHELL
========================================================= */

var SOURCES={
main:'.campaign-landing-page-container',
gamemaster:'#sidebar .sidebar-party-members .game-master',
stats:'#campaign-quick-stats',
stream:'#sidebar .campaign-stream-module.module'
};

function isHomePage(){
return document.body && document.body.classList.contains('campaign-landing-show');
}

function addShell(html){
var existing=document.getElementById('lcars-mkii-op-shell-host');
if(existing) return existing;

var host=document.createElement('div');
host.id='lcars-mkii-op-shell-host';
host.innerHTML=html;

var banner=document.querySelector('#banner-container');
if(banner){
banner.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',host);
host.style.marginTop='-'+(banner.offsetHeight||0)+'px';
}else{
var target=document.querySelector('#content')||document.querySelector('#wrapper')||document.body;
target.insertBefore(host,target.firstChild);
}
return host;
}

function moveElement(selector,targetId){
var source=document.querySelector(selector);
var target=document.getElementById(targetId);
if(!source||!target||source===target||source.contains(target)||target.contains(source)) return false;

source.setAttribute('data-lcars-mkii-adapted','true');
target.appendChild(source);
return true;
}

/* =========================================================
AREA 2 - GAMEMASTER
========================================================= */

function buildGameMaster(){
var area=document.getElementById('lcars-mkii-area-2');
var original=area && area.querySelector('.game-master');
if(!area||!original||area.querySelector('.lcars-gm-card')) return false;

var sourceImage=original.querySelector('img');
var card=document.createElement('div');
card.className='lcars-gm-card';

if(sourceImage){
var portrait=sourceImage.cloneNode(true);
portrait.className='lcars-gm-portrait';
card.appendChild(portrait);
}

var name=document.createElement('a');
name.className='lcars-gm-name';
name.href='https://www.obsidianportal.com/profile/GM_HOOLY';
name.textContent='GM_HOOLY';
name.setAttribute('aria-label','GM_HOOLY profile');
card.appendChild(name);

area.insertBefore(card,original);
original.style.display='none';
original.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
return true;
}

/* =========================================================
AREA 3 - PERSONNEL
========================================================= */

/* Personnel behaviour lives in personnel-widget.js. */

/* =========================================================
AREA 4 - ASSEMBLY / CONTEXT
========================================================= */

function movePageContent(){
return moveElement(SOURCES.main,'lcars-mkii-area-1');
}

function moveGameMaster(){
return moveElement(SOURCES.gamemaster,'lcars-mkii-area-2');
}

function moveStats(){
return moveElement(SOURCES.stats,'lcars-mkii-area-4');
}

function moveCampaignStream(){
var source=document.querySelector(SOURCES.stream);
var target=document.getElementById('lcars-mkii-area-4');
if(!source||!target) return false;
if(source.parentNode!==target) target.appendChild(source);
source.classList.add('lcars-mkii-op-stream');
return true;
}

function startCampaignStreamAutoScroll(){
var stream=document.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-area-4 .campaign-stream-module')||document.querySelector('.campaign-stream-module')||document.querySelector(SOURCES.stream);
if(!stream||stream.getAttribute('data-lcars-auto-scroll')==='true') return false;

stream.setAttribute('data-lcars-auto-scroll','true');

var list=stream.querySelector('ul,ol');
if(!list) return false;

if(list.getAttribute('data-lcars-scroll-copy')!=='true'){
var copy=list.cloneNode(true);
copy.setAttribute('data-lcars-scroll-copy','true');
copy.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
stream.appendChild(copy);
}

var position=0;
var loopHeight=0;
var copy=stream.querySelector('[data-lcars-scroll-copy="true"]');
var timer=setInterval(function(){
if(!document.body||!document.body.contains(stream)){
clearInterval(timer);
return;
}

if(!copy||!document.body.contains(copy)){
copy=stream.querySelector('[data-lcars-scroll-copy="true"]');
}

if(!copy) return;

loopHeight=copy.getBoundingClientRect().top-list.getBoundingClientRect().top;
if(loopHeight<=0) return;

position+=0.35;

if(position>=loopHeight){
position-=loopHeight;
}

stream.scrollTop=position;
},40);

return true;
}

function findFanModule(){
var selectors=['#sidebar .campaign-fans.module','#sidebar .sidebar-fans.module','#sidebar .fans.module','#sidebar [class*="fan"][class*="module"]','.campaign-fans.module','.sidebar-fans.module','.fans.module','[class*="fan"][class*="module"]'];
var source=null;
for(var i=0;i<selectors.length;i++){
source=document.querySelector(selectors[i]);
if(source) return source;
}
var modules=document.querySelectorAll('#sidebar .module, .campaign-fans.module, .sidebar-fans.module, .fans.module, [class*="fan"][class*="module"]');
for(var j=0;j<modules.length;j++){
var txt=(modules[j].textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
var cls=((modules[j].className||'')+' '+(modules[j].id||'')).toLowerCase();
if(cls.indexOf('fan')>-1||txt.indexOf('become a fan')>-1||txt.indexOf('you are a fan')>-1){
return modules[j];
}
}
return null;
}

function extractNumberNearLabel(text,label){
var safe=label.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&');
var m=text.match(new RegExp(safe+'\\s*[:\\-]?\\s*([0-9][0-9,]*)','i'));
if(m) return m[1].replace(/,/g,'');
m=text.match(new RegExp('([0-9][0-9,]*)\\s*'+safe,'i'));
if(m) return m[1].replace(/,/g,'');
return null;
}

function extractFanCount(source){
if(!source) return '0';
var text=(source.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
var value=extractNumberNearLabel(text,'fans');
if(value!==null) return value;
var nodes=source.querySelectorAll('[data-count],[data-fans],[data-fan-count]');
for(var i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){
var raw=nodes[i].getAttribute('data-count')||nodes[i].getAttribute('data-fans')||nodes[i].getAttribute('data-fan-count');
if(raw&&/^[0-9][0-9,]*$/.test(raw)) return raw.replace(/,/g,'');
}
return '0';
}

function findFanAction(source){
if(!source) return null;
var nodes=source.querySelectorAll('a,button,input[type=button],input[type=submit]');
for(var i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){
var txt=(nodes[i].textContent||nodes[i].value||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
var href=(nodes[i].getAttribute('href')||'').toLowerCase();
var cls=(nodes[i].className||'').toString().toLowerCase();
var title=(nodes[i].getAttribute('title')||'').toLowerCase();
var aria=(nodes[i].getAttribute('aria-label')||'').toLowerCase();
if(txt.indexOf('become a fan')>-1||txt.indexOf('you are a fan')>-1||txt.indexOf('unfan')>-1||href.indexOf('fan')>-1||cls.indexOf('fan')>-1||title.indexOf('fan')>-1||aria.indexOf('fan')>-1){
return nodes[i];
}
}
return null;
}

function triggerFanAction(){
var source=findFanModule();
var action=findFanAction(source);
if(!action) return false;
try{
action.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window}));
}catch(e){
try{action.click();}catch(ignore){}
}
return true;
}

function isFan(source,action){
var text=((source&&source.textContent)||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
if(text.indexOf('you are a fan')>-1||text.indexOf('unfan')>-1) return true;
if(action){
var actionText=(action.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
if(actionText.indexOf('you are a fan')>-1||actionText.indexOf('unfan')>-1) return true;
}
return false;
}

function countStatusFeed(){
var stream=document.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-area-4 .campaign-stream-module')||document.querySelector('.campaign-stream-module')||document.querySelector(SOURCES.stream);
if(!stream) return '0';
var text=(stream.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
var value=extractNumberNearLabel(text,'comments');
if(value!==null) return value;
var comments=stream.querySelectorAll('.comment,[class*="comment"]');
if(comments.length) return String(comments.length);
var entries=stream.querySelectorAll('li');
return String(entries.length);
}

function installArea5ButtonAnimation(){
if(document.getElementById('lcars-area5-button-animation')) return;
var style=document.createElement('style');
style.id='lcars-area5-button-animation';
style.textContent="\n#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-info-button{position:relative;overflow:hidden}\n#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-info-button::before{content:\"\";position:absolute;left:-34px;top:0;width:28px;height:100%;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.30),transparent);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:lcars-area5-info-sweep 4.8s ease-in-out infinite}\n#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-info-label,#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-info-triangle{position:relative;z-index:1}\n#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-info-triangle{animation:lcars-area5-info-triangle 4.8s ease-in-out infinite}\n#lcars-mkii-area-5 #lcars-area5-status-button::before,#lcars-mkii-area-5 #lcars-area5-status-button .lcars-area5-info-triangle{animation-delay:2.4s}\n@keyframes lcars-area5-info-sweep{0%,18%{transform:translateX(0) skewX(-18deg);opacity:0}22%{opacity:1}48%{transform:translateX(135px) skewX(-18deg);opacity:1}54%,100%{transform:translateX(135px) skewX(-18deg);opacity:0}}\n@keyframes lcars-area5-info-triangle{0%,50%{filter:brightness(1);transform:scale(1)}54%{filter:brightness(1.65);transform:scale(1.12)}60%,100%{filter:brightness(1);transform:scale(1)}}\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-info-button::before,#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-info-triangle{animation:none}}\n";
document.head.appendChild(style);
}

function buildArea5(){
var area=document.getElementById('lcars-mkii-area-5');
if(!area||area.getAttribute('data-lcars-area5-built')==='true') return false;

var source=findFanModule();
var action=findFanAction(source);
var count=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-fan-count');
var comments=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-comment-count');
var button=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-fan-button');
var image=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-fan-button-image');
if(!count||!comments||!button||!image) return false;

count.textContent=extractFanCount(source);
comments.textContent=countStatusFeed();
var popButton=document.getElementById('lcars-area5-population-button');
var statusButton=document.getElementById('lcars-area5-status-button');
if(popButton){popButton.querySelector('.lcars-area5-info-label').textContent='POPULATION: '+count.textContent;popButton.setAttribute('aria-label','POPULATION: '+count.textContent);}
if(statusButton){statusButton.querySelector('.lcars-area5-info-label').textContent='STATUS FEED: '+comments.textContent;statusButton.setAttribute('aria-label','STATUS FEED: '+comments.textContent);}

function makeArea5InfoButton(id,label,value,top,action){
var old=document.getElementById(id);
if(old) old.remove();
var b=document.createElement('a');
b.id=id;
b.href='#';
b.innerHTML='<span class="lcars-area5-info-label"></span><span class="lcars-area5-info-triangle" aria-hidden="true"></span>';b.querySelector('.lcars-area5-info-label').textContent=label+' '+value;
b.setAttribute('aria-label',label+' '+value);
b.setAttribute('role','button');
b.style.position='absolute';
b.style.left='8px';
b.style.top=top+'px';
b.style.width='83px';
b.style.height='21px';
b.style.margin='0';
b.style.padding='0 5px';
b.style.border='0';
b.style.borderRadius='6px';
b.style.background='#f79a69';
b.style.color='#000';
b.style.fontFamily='Antonio,Arial,sans-serif';
b.style.fontSize='10px';
b.style.fontWeight='600';
b.style.lineHeight='21px';
b.style.textAlign='left';
b.style.display='flex';
b.style.alignItems='center';
b.style.justifyContent='space-between';
b.style.boxSizing='border-box';
b.style.whiteSpace='nowrap';
b.style.overflow='hidden';
b.style.cursor='pointer';
b.style.zIndex='9999';
b.style.pointerEvents='auto';
var txt=b.querySelector('.lcars-area5-info-label');
txt.style.display='block';
txt.style.flex='1';
txt.style.minWidth='0';
var tri=b.querySelector('.lcars-area5-info-triangle');
tri.style.display='block';
tri.style.width='0';
tri.style.height='0';
tri.style.borderTop='7px solid transparent';
tri.style.borderBottom='7px solid transparent';
tri.style.borderLeft='10px solid #c94f53';
tri.style.marginRight='2px';
tri.style.flex='0 0 auto';
b.onclick=function(event){
event.preventDefault();
event.stopPropagation();
action();
return false;
};
area.appendChild(b);
return b;
}

count.style.display='none';
comments.style.display='none';
var popLabel=document.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-population');
var statusLabel=document.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-area-5 .lcars-area5-status');
if(popLabel) popLabel.style.display='none';
if(statusLabel) statusLabel.style.display='none';
var popButton=makeArea5InfoButton('lcars-area5-population-button','POPULATION:',count.textContent,28,function(){
if(window.jQuery) window.jQuery('#campaign-fans-modal').foundation('reveal','open');
});
var statusButton=makeArea5InfoButton('lcars-area5-status-button','STATUS FEED:',comments.textContent,52,function(){
if(window.jQuery) window.jQuery('#campaign-comments-modal').foundation('reveal','open');
});
popButton.classList.add('lcars-area5-info-button');
statusButton.classList.add('lcars-area5-info-button');
installArea5ButtonAnimation();

if(!window.lcarsArea5InfoClickBound){
document.addEventListener('click',function(event){
var pop=document.getElementById('lcars-area5-population-button');
var status=document.getElementById('lcars-area5-status-button');
var x=event.clientX,y=event.clientY;
if(pop){
var pr=pop.getBoundingClientRect();
if(x>=pr.left&&x<=pr.right&&y>=pr.top&&y<=pr.bottom){
event.preventDefault();
event.stopPropagation();
if(window.jQuery) window.jQuery('#campaign-fans-modal').foundation('reveal','open');
return;
}
}
if(status){
var sr=status.getBoundingClientRect();
if(x>=sr.left&&x<=sr.right&&y>=sr.top&&y<=sr.bottom){
event.preventDefault();
event.stopPropagation();
if(window.jQuery) window.jQuery('#campaign-comments-modal').foundation('reveal','open');
}
}
},true);
window.lcarsArea5InfoClickBound=true;
}

var fan=isFan(source,action);
if(!area5DefaultButtonSrc) area5DefaultButtonSrc=image.src;
var yaafSrc='data:image/svg+xml;base64,';
image.src=fan?yaafSrc:area5DefaultButtonSrc;
image.alt=fan?'You Are A Fan':'Become A Fan';
button.setAttribute('aria-label',fan?'You Are A Fan':'Become A Fan');

button.href='#';
button.onclick=function(event){
event.preventDefault();
if(triggerFanAction()){
var checks=0;
var poll=setInterval(function(){
refreshArea5();
if(++checks>=8) clearInterval(poll);
},300);
}
};

if(source){
source.style.display='none';
source.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
source.setAttribute('data-lcars-mkii-adapted','true');
}

area.setAttribute('data-lcars-area5-built','true');
return true;
}

function refreshArea5(){
var area=document.getElementById('lcars-mkii-area-5');
if(!area) return false;
var source=findFanModule();
var action=findFanAction(source);
var count=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-fan-count');
var comments=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-comment-count');
var button=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-fan-button');
var image=document.querySelector('#lcars-area5-fan-button-image');
if(!count||!comments||!button||!image) return false;

count.textContent=extractFanCount(source);
comments.textContent=countStatusFeed();
var popButton=document.getElementById('lcars-area5-population-button');
var statusButton=document.getElementById('lcars-area5-status-button');
if(popButton){popButton.querySelector('.lcars-area5-info-label').textContent='POPULATION: '+count.textContent;popButton.setAttribute('aria-label','POPULATION: '+count.textContent);}
if(statusButton){statusButton.querySelector('.lcars-area5-info-label').textContent='STATUS FEED: '+comments.textContent;statusButton.setAttribute('aria-label','STATUS FEED: '+comments.textContent);}

var fan=isFan(source,action);
if(!area5DefaultButtonSrc) area5DefaultButtonSrc=image.src;
var yaafSrc='data:image/svg+xml;base64,';
image.src=fan?yaafSrc:area5DefaultButtonSrc;
image.alt=fan?'You Are A Fan':'Become A Fan';
button.setAttribute('aria-label',fan?'You Are A Fan':'Become A Fan');
button.href='#';
button.onclick=function(event){
event.preventDefault();
if(triggerFanAction()){
var checks=0;
var poll=setInterval(function(){
refreshArea5();
if(++checks>=8) clearInterval(poll);
},300);
}
};

return true;
}

/* =========================================================
AREA 5 - NAVIGATION / STATUS
========================================================= */

/* Authoritative button map.
Assembly coordinates are Y=168,208,...,528.
Panel 2 begins at Y=105, so DOM-local Y is Assembly Y - 105.
Front Cap = X0..32, Main = X32..128, both 32px high. */
var MENU=[
{id:'home',label:'HOME',y:168,top:63,href:'/'},
{id:'personnel',label:'PERSONNEL',y:208,top:103,href:'/characters'},
{id:'computer-core',label:'COMPUTER CORE',y:248,top:143,href:'/wikis/main-page'},
{id:'mission-logs',label:'MISSION LOGS',y:288,top:183,href:'/adventure-log'},
{id:'resources',label:'RESOURCES',y:328,top:223,href:'/wikis/resources'},
{id:'engineering',label:'ENGINEERING',y:368,top:263,href:'/wikis/engineering'},
{id:'exobiology',label:'EXOBIOLOGY',y:408,top:303,href:'/wikis/exobiology'},
{id:'navigation',label:'NAVIGATION',y:448,top:343,href:'/maps'},
{id:'science',label:'SCIENCE',y:488,top:383,href:'/wikis/science'},
{id:'starships',label:'STARSHIPS',y:528,top:423,href:'/wikis/starships'}
];

function addMenuLinks(){
var panel=document.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-op-shell-host .panel-panel-2 .lcars-panel-content');
if(!panel) return false;

var items=panel.querySelectorAll('.lcars-menu-item[data-button]');
return items.length===MENU.length;
}

function updateMenuActiveState(){
var panel=document.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-op-shell-host .panel-panel-2 .lcars-panel-content');
if(!panel||!window.location) return false;

var path=window.location.pathname||'/';
var activeId='';

MENU.forEach(function(item){
var target=item.href||'/';
var match=false;

if(target==='/'){
match=path==='/';
}else{
match=path===target || path.indexOf(target+'/')===0;
}

if(match && (!activeId || target.length>(MENU.filter(function(m){return m.id===activeId;})[0]||{href:''}).href.length)){
activeId=item.id;
}
});

MENU.forEach(function(item){
var button=panel.querySelector('.lcars-menu-item[data-button="'+item.id+'"]');
if(!button) return;

var active=item.id===activeId;
button.classList.toggle('is-active',active);

if(active){
button.setAttribute('aria-current','page');
button.setAttribute('data-lcars-mkii-active','true');
}else{
button.removeAttribute('aria-current');
button.removeAttribute('data-lcars-mkii-active');
}
});

return true;
}

/* =========================================================
AREA 1-5 - PAGE ADAPTATION
========================================================= */

function adaptPage(){
var result={
area1:movePageContent(),
area2:moveGameMaster(),
area3:false,
area4:moveCampaignStream(),
area5:buildArea5()
};

document.body.classList.add('lcars-mkii-op-active');
document.documentElement.classList.add('lcars-mkii-op-active');
document.documentElement.style.background='#000';
document.body.style.background='#000';

var wrapper=document.querySelector('#wrapper');
if(wrapper) wrapper.style.background='#000';

var content=document.querySelector('#content');
if(content) content.style.background='#000';

buildGameMaster();
startCampaignStreamAutoScroll();
refreshArea5();
result.menu=addMenuLinks();
result.menuActive=updateMenuActiveState();
return result;
}

/* =========================================================
STARTUP
========================================================= */

function startHomeNumberAnimation(host){
if(!host||host.getAttribute('data-lcars-home-numbers-animated')==='true') return false;
var layer=host.querySelector('.lcars-number-overlay-layer');
if(!layer) return false;
var style=document.createElement('style');
style.textContent='#lcars-mkii-op-shell-host .lcars-mkii-home-number-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:inherit;width:max-content}#lcars-mkii-op-shell-host .lcars-mkii-home-number-row{display:block;color:#000!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#000!important;text-shadow:none!important;transition:color .18s ease,text-shadow .18s ease}#lcars-mkii-op-shell-host .lcars-mkii-home-number-row.is-active{color:#fecd9a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fecd9a!important;text-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(254,205,154,.55)!important}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#lcars-mkii-op-shell-host .lcars-mkii-home-number-row{transition:none}}';
host.appendChild(style);
var reduced=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
layer.querySelectorAll('.lcars-number-overlay').forEach(function(readout){
var values=(readout.textContent||'').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
if(!values.length) return;
var stack=document.createElement('span');
stack.className='lcars-mkii-home-number-stack';
var rows=[];
values.forEach(function(value){var row=document.createElement('span');row.className='lcars-mkii-home-number-row';row.textContent=value;stack.appendChild(row);rows.push(row);});
readout.textContent='';
readout.appendChild(stack);
if(reduced) return;
var order=[],last=-1,index=0;
function shuffle(){order=rows.map(function(_,i){return i;});for(var i=order.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)),tmp=order[i];order[i]=order[j];order[j]=tmp;}if(order.length>1&&order[0]===last){var swap=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*(order.length-1)),first=order[0];order[0]=order[swap];order[swap]=first;}index=0;}
function lightNext(){if(!host.isConnected)return;if(index>=order.length)shuffle();rows.forEach(function(row){row.classList.remove('is-active');});last=order[index++];rows[last].classList.add('is-active');window.setTimeout(lightNext,850+Math.floor(Math.random()*1151));}
shuffle();window.setTimeout(lightNext,Math.floor(Math.random()*700));
});
host.setAttribute('data-lcars-home-numbers-animated','true');
return true;
}
function init(){
if(!isHomePage()) return;

fetch(SHELL_URL,{cache:'no-store'})
.then(function(response){
if(!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+response.status);
return response.text();
})
.then(function(html){
addShell(html);
var result=adaptPage();
startHomeNumberAnimation(document.getElementById('lcars-mkii-op-shell-host'));
window.LCARS_MKII_OP_BRIDGE={
version:VERSION,
pageType:'home',
shellUrl:SHELL_URL,
result:result,
adapt:adaptPage
};
})
.catch(function(error){
console.warn('LCARS Mk II shell could not be loaded from '+SHELL_URL+'. Check fetch/CORS access.',error);
});
}

}

function addMainShell(html){
  var existing=document.getElementById(HOST_ID);
  if(existing) return existing;
  var host=document.createElement("div");
  host.id=HOST_ID;
  host.innerHTML=html;
  stripTruncationNotice(host);
  host.style.cssText="position:relative;left:0;width:1360px;min-width:1360px;height:1030.625px;margin-left:calc((100% - 1360px)/2);margin-top:0;padding:0;background:transparent;z-index:1000;overflow:visible;transform:none;";
  var banner=document.querySelector("#banner-container");
  if(banner && banner.parentNode){
    banner.parentNode.insertBefore(host,banner.nextSibling);
    host.style.marginTop="-"+(banner.offsetHeight||0)+"px";
  }else{
    var target=document.querySelector("#content")||document.querySelector("#wrapper")||document.body;
    target.insertBefore(host,target.firstChild);
  }
  return host;
}

function stripTruncationNotice(root){
  if(!root) return;
  var walker=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),nodes=[],node;
  var notice=/^\s*\*{0,2}Warning:\s*truncated output\s*\(original token count:\s*\d+\)\s*Total output lines:\s*\d+\s*svg\*{0,2}\s*$/i;
  while((node=walker.nextNode())) if(notice.test(node.nodeValue||"")) nodes.push(node);
  nodes.forEach(function(text){if(text.parentNode) text.parentNode.removeChild(text);});
}

function revealAreaOneGraph(target,source){
  [target,source].filter(Boolean).forEach(function(root){
    root.style.setProperty("background-color","transparent","important");
    root.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){
      var bg=window.getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor;
      if(bg==="rgb(0, 0, 0)"||bg==="rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)") el.style.setProperty("background-color","transparent","important");
    });
  });
}

function moveMainPageContent(host){
  var source=document.querySelector("main.main-content .wiki-page-container .post-main [itemprop='text']");
  var target=host.querySelector("#lcars-mkii-main-area-m01-content");
  if(!source||!target||source===target||target.contains(source)) return false;
  stripTruncationNotice(source);
  target.appendChild(source);
  revealAreaOneGraph(target,source);
  return true;
}

function hideNativeNavigation(){
  var nav=document.querySelector("#campaign-nav");
  if(!nav) return false;
  var navNames={"dashboard":1,"secrets":1,"home page":1,"forum":1,"calendar":1,"adventure log":1,"media library":1,"wiki":1,"characters":1,"items":1,"maps":1,"settings":1};
  nav.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(function(a){
    var label=(a.textContent||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().toLowerCase();
    if(!navNames[label]) return;
    a.style.setProperty("display","none","important");
    var item=a.closest ? a.closest("li") : null;
    if(item) item.style.setProperty("display","none","important");
  });
  return true;
}

function addTitleOverlays(host){
  var stage=host.querySelector("#lcars-mkii-main-stage");
  var layer=host.querySelector("#lcars-mkii-main-title-layer");
  if(!stage||!layer) return false;
  var labels=[
    {pill:"b-area-m05-pill",text:"DIPLOMATIC STATUS"},
    {pill:"b-area-m06-pill",text:"DIAGNOSTIC AUDIT"},
    {pill:"b-area-m07-pill",text:"DATABASE ENTRIES"},
    {pill:"b-area-m08-pill",text:"LEVEL 2 DIAGNOSTIC"},
    {pill:"b-lcars2-pill1",text:"EXCALIBUR COMPUTER CORE"}
  ];
  var stageRect=stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  var scaleX=stageRect.width/(stage.offsetWidth||1024);
  var scaleY=stageRect.height/(stage.offsetHeight||776);
  labels.forEach(function(item){
    var pill=stage.querySelector("#"+item.pill);
    if(!pill) return;
    var box=pill.getBoundingClientRect();
    var left=(box.left-stageRect.left)/scaleX;
    var top=(box.top-stageRect.top)/scaleY;
    var width=box.width/scaleX;
    var height=box.height/scaleY;
    var isLongPill=item.pill==="b-lcars2-pill1";
    var grow=isLongPill?3/scaleY:0;
    var sidePad=isLongPill?5+(5/scaleX):5;
    var labelHeight=height+grow;
    var label=document.createElement("div");
    label.className="lcars-mkii-main-title";
    var titleText=document.createElement("span");
    titleText.className="lcars-mkii-main-title-text";
    titleText.style.display="inline-block";
    titleText.textContent=item.text;
    titleText.style.transform="translateY("+(-2/scaleY)+"px)";
    label.appendChild(titleText);
    label.style.color=pill.getAttribute("fill")||"#fff";
    label.style.left=(left+width/2)+"px";
    label.style.top=(top+height/2-grow/2)+"px";
    label.style.width="max-content";
    label.style.height=labelHeight+"px";
    label.style.lineHeight=labelHeight+"px";
    label.style.fontSize=labelHeight+"px";
    label.style.paddingLeft=sidePad+"px";
    label.style.paddingRight=sidePad+"px";
    label.style.transform="translate(-50%,-50%)";
    layer.appendChild(label);
    var size=labelHeight;
    while(label.scrollWidth>Math.max(0,width-(2*sidePad))&&size>8){
      size-=0.5;
      label.style.fontSize=size+"px";
      label.style.lineHeight=labelHeight+"px";
    }
    var canvas=document.createElement("canvas");
    var context=canvas.getContext("2d");
    if(context){
      var computed=window.getComputedStyle(label);
      context.font=computed.font;
      var metrics=context.measureText(item.text);
      label.style.setProperty("--lcars-title-backplate-width",(metrics.width+(sidePad*2))+"px");
      var padTop=5/scaleY;
      var padBottom=10/scaleY;
      var actualAscent=metrics.actualBoundingBoxAscent;
      var actualDescent=metrics.actualBoundingBoxDescent;
      var fontAscent=metrics.fontBoundingBoxAscent;
      var fontDescent=metrics.fontBoundingBoxDescent;
      var backplateHeight;
      var backplateOffsetY;
      if(isFinite(actualAscent)&&isFinite(actualDescent)&&isFinite(fontAscent)&&isFinite(fontDescent)){
        var baselineOffsetY=((labelHeight-(fontAscent+fontDescent))/2)+fontAscent;
        var glyphCenterOffsetY=baselineOffsetY+((actualDescent-actualAscent)/2)-(labelHeight/2);
        backplateHeight=actualAscent+actualDescent+padTop+padBottom;
        backplateOffsetY=glyphCenterOffsetY+(grow/2)+((padBottom-padTop)/2);
      }else{
        backplateHeight=height+padTop+padBottom;
        backplateOffsetY=(grow/2)+((padBottom-padTop)/2);
      }
      label.style.setProperty("--lcars-title-backplate-height",backplateHeight+"px");
      label.style.setProperty("--lcars-title-backplate-offset-y",backplateOffsetY+"px");
    }
  });
  return true;
}

function addAnimatedPanelReadouts(host){
  var layer=host.querySelector("#lcars-mkii-main-readout-layer");
  if(!layer||layer.childElementCount) return false;
  var strips=[
    {id:"left",cls:"left",values:["8454-272","1138-306","2366-357","8522-082"]},
    {id:"magenta",cls:"magenta",values:["6215-083","8472-619","7184-250","1701-069","4827-316","7159-204","8912-543","1548-729","5392-553"]},
    {id:"blue",cls:"blue",values:["6370-185","5703-962","2185-634","7631-450","8817-925"]}
  ];
  var reduced=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  strips.forEach(function(strip){
    var group=document.createElement("div");
    group.className="lcars-mkii-main-readout lcars-mkii-main-readout-"+strip.cls;
    group.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
    var rows=[];
    strip.values.forEach(function(value){
      var row=document.createElement("span");
      row.className="lcars-mkii-main-readout-number";
      row.textContent=value;
      group.appendChild(row);
      rows.push(row);
    });
    layer.appendChild(group);
    if(reduced) return;
    var order=[],last=-1,index=0;
    function shuffle(){
      order=rows.map(function(_,i){return i;});
      for(var i=order.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)),tmp=order[i];order[i]=order[j];order[j]=tmp;}
      if(order.length>1&&order[0]===last){var swap=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*(order.length-1)),first=order[0];order[0]=order[swap];order[swap]=first;}
      index=0;
    }
    function lightNext(){
      if(!host.isConnected) return;
      if(index>=order.length) shuffle();
      rows.forEach(function(row){row.classList.remove("is-active");});
      last=order[index++];
      rows[last].classList.add("is-active");
      window.setTimeout(lightNext,850+Math.floor(Math.random()*1151));
    }
    shuffle();
    window.setTimeout(lightNext,Math.floor(Math.random()*700));
  });
  return true;
}
function activateMenu(host){
  var active=(location.pathname||"").replace(/\/+$/,"");
  host.querySelectorAll("#lcars-mkii-main-menu a[data-lcars-menu]").forEach(function(a){
    var href=a.getAttribute("href")||"";
    var selected=(href==="/wikis/main-page" && active==="/wikis/main-page");
    if(selected){a.setAttribute("aria-current","page");a.classList.add("is-active");}
    else{a.removeAttribute("aria-current");a.classList.remove("is-active");}
  });
}

function ensureHomeDataFrame(){
  var frame=document.getElementById("lcars-mkii-main-home-data-frame");
  if(frame) return frame;
  frame=document.createElement("iframe");
  frame.id="lcars-mkii-main-home-data-frame";
  frame.title="Home page status source";
  frame.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
  frame.tabIndex=-1;
  frame.src="/";
  frame.style.cssText="position:fixed!important;left:-10000px!important;top:0!important;width:1360px!important;height:900px!important;opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;border:0!important";
  document.body.appendChild(frame);
  return frame;
}
function readHomeDiplomaticStatus(){
  var frame=document.getElementById("lcars-mkii-main-home-data-frame");
  try{
    var doc=frame&&frame.contentDocument;
    if(!doc) return null;
    var pop=doc.getElementById("lcars-area5-population-button");
    var feed=doc.getElementById("lcars-area5-status-button");
    var fan=doc.getElementById("lcars-area5-fan-button");
    if(!pop||!feed||!fan) return null;
    var popText=pop.getAttribute("aria-label")||pop.textContent||"";
    var feedText=feed.getAttribute("aria-label")||feed.textContent||"";
    var popMatch=popText.match(/POPULATION\s*:\s*([0-9][0-9,]*)/i);
    var feedMatch=feedText.match(/STATUS\s+FEED\s*:\s*([0-9][0-9,]*)/i);
    if(!popMatch||!feedMatch) return null;
    return {population:popMatch[1].replace(/,/g,""),feed:feedMatch[1].replace(/,/g,""),fan:((fan.getAttribute("aria-label")||"").toLowerCase().indexOf("you are a fan")>-1)};
  }catch(e){return null;}
}
function triggerHomeFanAction(){
  var frame=document.getElementById("lcars-mkii-main-home-data-frame");
  try{
    var shared=frame&&frame.contentWindow&&frame.contentWindow.LCARS_MKII_AREA5_SHARED;
    return !!(shared&&shared.triggerFanAction&&shared.triggerFanAction());
  }catch(e){return false;}
}
function refreshMainDiplomaticStatus(host){
  var area=host&&host.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-area-m05');
  if(!area) return false;
  var shared=window.LCARS_MKII_AREA5_SHARED;
  if(!shared) return false;
  var homeStatus=readHomeDiplomaticStatus();
  if(!homeStatus){
    ensureHomeDataFrame();
    return false;
  }
  var population=area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-population-label');
  var feed=area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-status-label');
  var button=area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-fan-button');
  var image=button&&button.querySelector('img');
  if(!population||!feed||!button||!image) return false;
  var fanCount=homeStatus.population;
  var feedCount=homeStatus.feed;
  population.textContent='POPULATION: '+fanCount;
  feed.textContent='STATUS FEED: '+feedCount;
  area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-population-button').setAttribute('aria-label','POPULATION: '+fanCount);
  area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-status-button').setAttribute('aria-label','STATUS FEED: '+feedCount);
  var fan=homeStatus.fan;
  image.src=fan?image.getAttribute('data-yaaf-src'):image.getAttribute('data-baf-src');
  image.alt=fan?'You Are A Fan':'Become A Fan';
  button.setAttribute('aria-label',image.alt);
  return true;
}

function buildMainDiplomaticStatus(host){
  var area=host&&host.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-area-m05');
  if(!area||area.getAttribute('data-lcars-area5-built')==='true') return false;
  var population=area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-population-button');
  var feed=area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-status-button');
  var fan=area.querySelector('#lcars-mkii-main-fan-button');
  if(!population||!feed||!fan) return false;
  population.addEventListener('click',function(event){event.preventDefault();if(window.jQuery)window.jQuery('#campaign-fans-modal').foundation('reveal','open');});
  feed.addEventListener('click',function(event){event.preventDefault();if(window.jQuery)window.jQuery('#campaign-comments-modal').foundation('reveal','open');});
  fan.addEventListener('click',function(event){event.preventDefault();if(triggerHomeFanAction()){var checks=0;var poll=window.setInterval(function(){refreshMainDiplomaticStatus(host);if(++checks>=24)window.clearInterval(poll);},250);}});
  area.setAttribute('data-lcars-area5-built','true');
  ensureHomeDataFrame();
  var attempts=0;
  var timer=window.setInterval(function(){
    if(refreshMainDiplomaticStatus(host)||++attempts>=80) window.clearInterval(timer);
  },250);
  return true;
}
function finishMainPage(html){
  var host=addMainShell(html);
  moveMainPageContent(host);
  hideNativeNavigation();
  var nativePage=document.querySelector("main.main-content .wiki-page-container");
  if(nativePage) nativePage.style.setProperty("display","none","important");
  var sidebar=document.querySelector("#sidebar");
  if(sidebar) sidebar.style.setProperty("display","none","important");
  document.documentElement.classList.add("lcars-mkii-main-active");
  document.body.classList.add("lcars-mkii-main-active");
  document.documentElement.style.background="#000";
  document.body.style.background="#000";
  document.documentElement.style.overflowX="hidden";
  document.body.setAttribute("data-lcars-mkii-main-version",MAIN_VERSION);
  addTitleOverlays(host);
  buildMainDiplomaticStatus(host);
  addAnimatedPanelReadouts(host);
  addAreaOneButtonLinks(host);
  activateMenu(host);
  window.LCARS_MKII_MAIN_BRIDGE={version:MAIN_VERSION,pageType:"main",assembly:"1.10b",shellUrl:MAIN_SHELL_URL,hostId:HOST_ID};
  console.log("LCARS Mk II Main page v"+MAIN_VERSION+" loaded");
}

function initMainPage(){
  if(!isMainPage()) return;
  fetch(MAIN_SHELL_URL,{cache:"no-store"})
    .then(function(response){if(!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+response.status);return response.text();})
    .then(finishMainPage)
    .catch(function(error){console.warn("LCARS Mk II Main page shell could not be loaded from "+MAIN_SHELL_URL,error);});
}

if(document.readyState==="loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",initMainPage);
else initMainPage();
})();
